mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qnas (training_id, user_id, trainer_id, question_title, question, created_at) VALUES (#{trainingId}, #{traineeId}, #{trainerId}, #{questionTitle}, #{question}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT q.qna_id AS qnaId, u.username AS userName, -- ✅ users 테이블에서 가져오기 q.question_title AS questionTitle, q.question AS question, q.answer AS answer, q.created_at AS createAt, q.answered_at AS answeredAt FROM qnas q JOIN users u ON q.user_id = u.user_id -- ✅ JOIN WHERE q.training_id = #{trainingId} ORDER BY q.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE qnas SET answer = #{answer}, answered_at = NOW() WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
